title.zh: 中性上风空间推进系数

summary: Assemble forward/backward trapezoidal spatial coefficients Ak/Bk/Fk/Ck/Dk/Gk from metre coordinates, dimensionless u_x, alpha=nu/Vth in m^-1 and normalized source Q/Vth in F/m.

capability: Assemble forward/backward trapezoidal spatial coefficients Ak/Bk/Fk/Ck/Dk/Gk from metre coordinates, dimensionless u_x, alpha=nu/Vth in m^-1 and normalized source Q/Vth in F/m.
operation: assemble the neutral upwind transport coefficients
spatial nodes, velocity axis, collision frequency, source -> Ak/Bk/Fk/Ck/Dk/Gk + branch indices
discovery.model: Bidirectional trapezoidal discretization along each velocity characteristic; normalized spatial transport with u=v/Vth and inverse-length collision coefficients
discovery.geometry: one spatial dimension with two velocity branches (positive/negative vx); velocity axes are dimensionless u=v/Vth on one common caller normalization
discovery.boundary: x strictly increasing with >= 2 nodes and finite positive spatial steps, vx one-dimensional with no zero node, alpha/source finite 3-D aligned shapes, alpha nonnegative, vx must contain both positive and negative branches

identity.relation: source forward/backward trapezoidal transport coefficients for bidirectional neutral propagation
identity.direction: spatial nodes, velocity axis, collision frequency, source -> Ak/Bk/Fk/Ck/Dk/Gk + branch indices
identity.definition: Forward branch (positive vx): Ak = (2*vx - dx*alpha_k)/(2*vx + dx*alpha_{k+1}), Bk = dx/(2*vx + dx*alpha_{k+1}), Fk = dx*(source_{k+1}+source_k)/(2*vx + dx*alpha_{k+1}). Backward branch (negative vx): Ck/Dk/Gk analogous.
identity.model: Bidirectional trapezoidal discretization along each velocity characteristic
identity.geometry: one spatial dimension with two velocity branches (positive/negative vx)
identity.coordinates: x in m; vx is dimensionless u_x=v_x/Vth; alpha=nu/Vth is m^-1 and source_distribution is Q/Vth in F/m. Ak/Ck are dimensionless, Bk/Dk are m and Fk/Gk have distribution units F.
identity.boundary: x strictly increasing with >= 2 nodes and finite positive spatial steps, vx one-dimensional with no zero node, alpha/source finite 3-D aligned shapes, alpha nonnegative, vx must contain both positive and negative branches
assumptions: The declared recurrence applies the trapezoidal rule along each velocity characteristic; no additional flux correction is applied. Smooth constant-coefficient attenuation has second-order spatial error, but positivity is not guaranteed for arbitrary steps.
SciRel rejects boolean, string and complex coercions and any non-finite coefficient produced from finite inputs.
The vx axis must contain both positive and negative branches; a zero node is rejected.

The public transport convention is u=v/Vth on one caller-selected thermal-speed scale: alpha=nu/Vth has units m^-1, F integrates over normalized velocity volume to number density in m^-3, and every spatial source coefficient is Q/Vth in F/m. Physical rates in s^-1 must be divided by that same Vth before this spatial operator; no automatic conversion is performed.

inputs.name: x_m
inputs.constraints: Finite, strictly increasing, at least two nodes, with representable finite positive spatial steps.

inputs.name: vx
inputs.description: Dimensionless axial velocity u_x=v_x/Vth; use the same Vth as every inverse-length collision/source coefficient.
inputs.constraints: Finite one-dimensional; no zero nodes; must contain both positive and negative branches.

inputs.name: source_distribution
inputs.description: Normalized spatial distribution source Q/Vth; divide a physical F/s source by the same Vth before calling.

outputs.name: coefficients
outputs.dtype: mapping of [nvr,nvx,nx] float64 arrays and two index arrays
outputs.constraints: Exactly Ak, Bk, Fk, Ck, Dk, Gk (each [nvr,nvx,nx]), positive_vx_indices and negative_vx_indices. Ak/Ck are dimensionless, Bk/Dk are metres and Fk/Gk are in m^-3 (F).

preconditions: x strictly increasing >= 2 nodes; vx no zero, both branches present; alpha/source finite aligned 3-D.
Use one common Vth for normalized velocity nodes, inverse-length collision coefficients and spatial source coefficients; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion.
supported: Forward/backward trapezoidal transport coefficients for H and H2 neutral generation propagation.
excluded: Alternative spatial stencils; nonuniform velocity-axis weighting; conservative flux correction.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when x is not strictly increasing (>= 2 nodes), vx has a zero node or lacks a branch, alpha/source are not finite aligned 3-D, or alpha has negative entries.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if finite inputs overflow to non-finite transport coefficients.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

example.description: Assemble coefficients on a small mesh and confirm branch separation.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import assemble_neutral_upwind_transport_coefficients
x = np.linspace(0, 1, 3)
vx = np.array([-1.0, 1.0])
alpha = np.ones((2, 2, 3))
source = np.ones((2, 2, 3))
r = assemble_neutral_upwind_transport_coefficients(x, vx, alpha, source)
assert r['Ak'].shape == (2, 2, 3)
assert np.all(r['Ak'][:, 0, :] == 0.0)  # vx[0]=-1 is negative
assert np.all(r['Ck'][:, 1, :] == 0.0)  # vx[1]=+1 is positive
example.expected: The coefficient mapping had shape (2,2,3) for each transport field; Ak was zero on the negative branch and Ck was zero on the positive branch.

scope: Direct tests bind branch separation, the forward trapezoidal coefficient relation, real-value/finiteness validation and unrepresentable-step/output rejection.

The cross-domain tests feed these coefficients into actual propagation, compare fixed physical attenuation with an analytic characteristic, measure second-order error in one constant-coefficient case and preserve a prescribed source/loss equilibrium.
The contract example covers one bounded representative call; numerical checks do not establish external physical validation or full-domain applicability.
